name: writing
description: Publication-prep tools for academic and public-facing writing. Three skills: style (17 canonical English-prose rules, 19 page-cap additions, 2 audit-time rules), preflight (deterministic pre-submission checks on a LaTeX tree), and plot (one matplotlib style for posts and papers after Epoch AI's charts: Instrument Sans, light grid, baseline axis only, Google palette; style.py plus one example). The integrity-forensics suite is the separate anti-autoresearch plugin.
